headline: Al Maktoum International airport expansion moves forward rapidly
summary: Dubai World Central confirms the second runway will launch next year as planned. This upgrade will lift passenger capacity to 150 million annually.
why: Massive aviation expansions drive regional property demand and infrastructure growth.
impact_reason: Boosts regional connectivity and long-term property demand.

headline: Opec+ Maintains Steady Oil Production Targets for November
summary: The alliance has chosen to keep current production targets unchanged through November. This decision extends the output pause that began last month.
why: Oil market stability underpins overall economic confidence and investor sentiment in the UAE.
impact_reason: Maintains economic stability without direct property market changes.
